receipt.name: WarmWebp
receipt.jitPolicy: Tiered compilation disabled; fully optimized JIT before measurement
receipt.recipe: HorizontalFlipInput.Create(8): original 513x259 asymmetric RGBA8, phase zero, alpha zero at both first-row ends, hidden RGB unchanged. VP8 target is 8-bit 4:2:0 with exact source alpha; effort 4 on both subjects. No extra source raster.

nativeBuild.purpose: Original development-only warm WebP FFmpeg worker

receipt.boundary: Resident original RGBA8 to complete independent VP8 WebP bytes with exact alpha. Native codec/scratch/frame/packet wrappers reused; RGBA-to-BGRA repacking and complete encode execute every operation. Fresh managed MemoryStream creation, growth, encode and disposal included; no redundant ToArray. Both effort settings fixed at 4; managed fixed entropy and native adaptive coding declared. Alpha-weighted RGB source-error matching before composite rounding, <=0.25 dB fixed band; unweighted decoder agreement includes hidden RGB. Fresh geometry/decoder/alpha/source/ownership/bitstream checks before/after. Startup, IPC, I/O, fixture generation, quality enumeration and checks excluded.
